provenance: this session's mounted MCP namespace, transcribed from the deferred-tool listing the Claude Code client injects at session start (the `mcp__<server>__<tool>` prefixes it enumerated), bare names only to match the upstream name_bytes basis. Second instrument to the stdio handshake sweep, which cannot reach these rows at all: all 7 are HTTP transports recorded as `transport='http': no stdio command`.
measures: RESIDENT ONLY. Tool names are measured; schemas are not, and stay null for every row here. So the fleet RESIDENT total these rows complete is a true total, and the fleet CONTINGENT total remains a lower bound.
independence: transcription-independent, NOT instrument-independent: this transcription and the audit's read the same client listing, so a systematic error in the CLIENT would survive both. Settling experiment: an HTTP tools/list against each endpoint, which needs credentials this lane does not read.

controls.V1_matches_matrix_unsampled: both directions, or the run fails closed
controls.V2_no_double_count: no server may be both sampled and transcribed here
controls.V3_bare_names: no mcp__ prefix, no blank, no untrimmed name
controls.V4_no_duplicates: a repeated name would inflate count AND bytes
controls.V5_no_empty_server: an empty surface is a finding, not a default
controls.C_basis_reconciles: this module's name_bytes reproduces the committed value for all 16 sampled rows -- the new rows are commensurable with the old
controls.C_audit_corroborates: the audit's independent hand count agrees on all 7 rows, tools and bytes
